itemized.notes: Fully TYPED 2022 3-line form, three pages: p8 cover (October 25 - Nov 1 box ticked, signed 10/24/2022), p9 FORM A contributions, p10 FORM B expenditures - form order and page order agree here. Both schedules are rotated landscape sheets. Neither schedule prints a per-page subtotal; each prints one grand total at the foot ('to line 1 of report' / 'to line 2 of report') and both close to the cent against the cover. Cover line 1 'Totals from Last Report' is a bare dash on all three lines and stays BLANK in the stated-totals cache (zero-glyph ruling), so This Report == Cumulative. No in-kind items are labelled on either schedule. Donor street addresses printed in Form A's Address column are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY.md: city/state only).
